thread:
alex: Heads-up — large spike in fncall validation rejects in ap-south around 09:12 UTC, customers seeing tool errors and quota churn. Console: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/validators :warning:

priya: Any recent validator rollouts? We pushed a patch last night but only to staging as far as I know.

dev-bot: rollout.change: user=ci-bot promoted validator-v3.2 region=ap-south percent=100 -> 09:10:55 UTC

ops: That promotion shouldn't have happened. Checking automated pipeline triggers now. :mag_right:

alex: Quick metrics tail:
```
validator.rejects{region="ap-south",route="entity-extract"} = 870 (5m)
fallback.degen{route="entity-extract"} = 820 (5m)
quota.alerts{account=acct-77} = +12% (billing-notice)
```

ui-sam: UX impact: front-end surfaces "tool error" to customers. We should distinguish hard rejects vs soft warnings in the API headers. Right now it's confusing.

priya: Can someone run this query against validation_events so we know top rejection reasons?
```
SELECT reason, validator_sha, count(*) FROM validation_events WHERE region='ap-south' AND ts > now()-10m GROUP BY reason,validator_sha ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5;
```

infra: Found root cause: a cron job in /ci/pipelines/rollout-scripts invoked `promote-canary --force` due to a mis-specified env var. Filed infra-1578 to remove the force path.

alex: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) set policy to permissive for entity-extract in ap-south 2) add an alert for hard_reject_rate 3) capture top-50 sample payloads to S3 for triage.

alex: Command to flip policy:
`redwoodctl validators set --route entity-extract --region ap-south --policy permissive --reason "emergency rollback"`
dev-bot: validators.update: route=entity-extract region=ap-south policy=permissive requested_by=alex 09:25:11 UTC

ui-sam: Short-term Console change: expose per-route policy override with an audit trail link and a sampling slider (0-1000 samples/min). We'll make the sample panel collapsible so it doesn't clutter.

priya: Telemetry changes requested: include validator_git_sha and binding_hash on reject metrics, add `reject_type` tag with values schema_mismatch | enum_violation | missing_required, and a `soft_vs_hard` boolean. Also limit attached sample size (200 bytes) and redact PII.

ops: Alerting proposal: only page for hard_reject_rate > 0.05 sustained for 5m. Soft rejects should increment dashboards but not trigger paging. Prevent billing alarms from firing on soft rejects.

alex: Filing follow-ups: INF-10001 (cron + rollout guards), INF-10002 (metrics: reject_by_type panels + sample ingestion), INF-10003 (console: policy override UI + audit trail). Assigning INF-10002 -> priya, INF-10003 -> ui-sam, INF-10001 -> infra.

priya: I'll take INF-10002 and add a dashboard with: reject_rate, fallback_rate, top reject_type, validator_sha distribution, 1m granularity. Also will add a derived metric: rejection_cost_impact to flag potential billing issues.

ui-sam: Will open a small Console PR for the policy override visibility and audit link. Low-risk, feature-flagged.

ops: We'll patch the cron and add a CI gate to prevent `--force` in auto-promote paths.

alex: Thanks. Postmortem if this hits customers' billing or SSEs. Also retrospective item: tighten canary promotion policies and add human approval for >10% in prod regions. :memo:
